summary.name: Dubverse
summary.one_liner: Dubverse is an AI text-to-speech web tool that turns typed, pasted, or uploaded text into human-like voiceovers in many languages, with a TTS API for developers.
use_cases: Producing voiceovers for documentaries, how-to videos, and tech tutorials
Dubbing news segments or business content into multiple languages
Converting documents or scripts into audio
Building a consistent brand voice across languages
Adding text-to-speech to an app via API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web studio where users type, paste, or upload a document and convert it to speech for free. It offers 200+ speakers across 30+ languages (the page also mentions 60+ languages and 40+ in the meta description), with options for intonation, tone, accent, and age or gender. Projects can include multiple speakers for conversational voiceovers, custom pronunciation for dialects, and preview before publishing. Outputs can be downloaded in multiple formats and shared to social platforms or email. A Text-to-Speech API with custom voice models and reported sub-300ms latency is also offered.
notable: Single voices reused across multiple languages for consistent brand voice
Text-to-Speech API with custom voice models and under 300ms response time
caveats: Page does not state limits or paid tier details beyond 'Free to Start' and 'No Credit Card'
Language count is inconsistent on the page (30+, 40+, 60+)
